# Astronomical 0.2.88
## What changed
- **Claude Code runs on your local models.** `astronomical launch claude` starts Claude Code for one session pointed at this Mac: every model alias and the subagent model route to the local model, and Claude Code is given the model's real context window. Your saved Claude Code settings are left alone, and arguments after `--` go to Claude Code unchanged. - **An Anthropic-compatible Messages API.** The local API now serves `/v1/messages`, streaming and non-streaming, with tools and thinking control, plus `/v1/messages/count_tokens`, counted by the model's own tokenizer. Errors arrive in the Anthropic error format, and a prompt longer than the context window is reported the way Claude Code expects, so it compacts the conversation instead of failing. - **One model listing for both protocols.** `/v1/models` entries carry the Anthropic listing fields alongside the OpenAI ones, and each launcher offers only the models that serve its agent's protocol. - **Model catalog.** The REAP 19B model is no longer offered for download. - **Expert statistics.** Expert reads made while setting up a decode step are now counted under decode instead of prefill.
## Compatibility
The REST changes are additions; existing OpenAI-compatible requests are answered as before. There are no configuration-format changes. Your models, settings, and caches are preserved.
## Distribution
This release is signed with a Developer ID certificate, notarized by Apple, and delivered through the signed Sparkle update feed.
